quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 R&D and products (annual report): R&D spending RMB 62,916,157.57 (+44.43%), 5.37% of revenue; 196 R&D staff (15.21% of employees); 13 projects. Its low-Dk generation-1 and generation-2 fabrics passed customer certification and began volume production in 2025; low-CTE fabric reached volume production in 2025 and entered the package-substrate end-product supply chain. It is developing extra-thin fabric, extra-fine yarn, fabric for chip heat-dissipation boards and lower-Dk / lower-CTE fabrics, and improving quartz-fibre fabric weaving and processing.

quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company plan for 2026 (annual report): raise capacity of high-performance low-Dk and low-CTE fabrics and speed new-product development and volume output to replace imports and meet customers' incremental demand; raise high-end fabric gross margin and specialty fabric capacity and yield; keep developing, producing and expanding capacity for low-Dk generation 1 / generation 2 and low-CTE fabrics according to customer orders. The company calls 2025 the starting year of its high-end products; no numeric target is given.
